SMOS1:
Name: Login
Actors: Registered user
Description: Allows a user to log in to the system.
Preconditions: The user is not logged in. The user has a username and password. The user fills in and submits the login form.
Event sequence: System: 1. Checks that the username and password are at least 5 characters long; if so, goes to step 2, otherwise notifies the user of the error. 2. Searches the archive to see whether the username and password entered by the user are among the users allowed to log in. 3. If the search succeeds, the user is logged in to the system.
Postconditions: The system shows the workspace of the registered user. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS2:
Name: WrongLogin
Actors: Registered user
Description: Occurs when the user has entered wrong authentication data.
Preconditions: The data supplied for the login are not correct.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the login form.
Postconditions: The user can try to log in again.
SMOS3:
Name: Logout
Actors: Registered user
Description: Allows a user to leave the system.
Preconditions: The user is logged in. The user clicks the logout button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the login form.
Postconditions: The user can log in to the system again.
SMOS4:
Name: ChangePassword
Actors: Registered user
Description: Allows a user to change his or her own password.
Preconditions: The user is logged in. The user clicks the 'Change Password' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the form with the fields: old password, new password, confirm new password. User: 2. Fills in the form and submits. System: 3. Confirms that the password has been changed.
Postconditions: The user's password has been changed. The user cancels the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS5:
Name: ViewUserList
Actors: Administrator
Description: Shows the list of the users present in the system.
Preconditions: The user is logged in as administrator. The user clicks the 'User Management' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Searches the archive for the users and shows the list.
Postconditions: The system shows the list of the users present in the system. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS6:
Name: NewUser
Actors: Administrator
Description: Insertion of a new user into the system.
Preconditions: The user is logged in as administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewUserList' and the system is showing the list of the users present in the system. The user clicks the 'New User' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the user insertion form with the fields: first name, last name, e-mail, mobile phone, login, password, confirm password. User: 2. Fills in the form fields. 3. Clicks the 'Save' button. System: 4. Checks the validity of the entered data and inserts the new user into the archive; if the entered data are not valid, activates the use case 'DataError'.
Postconditions: A new user has been created. The data error is notified. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS7:
Name: ViewUserDetails
Actors: Administrator
Description: Shows the details of a user.
Preconditions: The user is logged in as administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewUserList' and the system is showing the list of the users present in the system. The user clicks the 'Details' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the detailed information of the user, in particular: first name, last name, e-mail, mobile phone, login, password.
Postconditions: The system shows the detailed information about a user. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS8:
Name: EditUser
Actors: Administrator
Description: Modification of one or more data items of a user present in the system.
Preconditions: The user is logged in as administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewUserDetails' and the system is showing the details of a user. The user modifies one or more items of information in the user details form.
Event sequence: User: 1. Clicks the 'edit' button. System: 2. Checks the validity of the entered data and modifies the user; if the entered data are not valid, activates the use case 'DataError'.
Postconditions: The user has been modified. The data error is notified. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS9:
Name: DeleteUser
Actors: Administrator
Description: Deletes a user from the system.
Preconditions: The user is logged in as administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewUserDetails' and the system is showing the details of a user. The user clicks the 'Delete' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Deletes the user from the archive. 2. Shows the updated list of users.
Postconditions: The user has been deleted. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS10:
Name: Assign/RemoveRolesOfAUser
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows assigning or removing roles of a user.
Preconditions: The user is logged in as administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewUserDetails' and the system is showing the details of a user. The user clicks the 'User Roles' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the role management form. User: 2. Selects the roles to assign to or remove from the user. 3. Clicks the 'Send' button. System: 4. Assigns or removes the roles of the user as indicated by the administrator.
Postconditions: The roles of the user have been modified. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS11:
Name: Assign/RemoveTeachingsOfATeacher
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows assigning or removing teachings (subjects taught) of a teacher.
Preconditions: The user is logged in as administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewUserDetails' and the system is showing the details of a teacher. The user clicks the 'Teacher Teachings' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the teaching management form for the teacher concerned. User: 2. Selects the academic year. System: 3. Shows the list of classes available for the selected year. User: 4. Selects the desired class. System: 5. Shows the list of teachings associated with that class. User: 6. Selects the teachings to associate with or remove from the teacher. System: 7. Assigns or removes the teachings of the teacher as indicated by the administrator.
Postconditions: One or more teachings have been assigned to or removed from the teacher. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS12:
Name: Assign/RemoveStudentsOfAParent
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows associating new students with a parent or removing the associations previously entered.
Preconditions: The user is logged in as administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewUserDetails' and the system is showing the details of a parent. The user clicks the 'Kinship' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the children management form for the parent concerned. User: 2. Selects the students to assign to or remove from the parent. 3. Clicks the 'Send' button. System: 4. Assigns/removes the students associated with a parent.
Postconditions: One or more children have been associated with or removed from a parent. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS13:
Name: ViewClassList
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows viewing the list of classes (school classes).
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system with the Administrator role. The user clicks the 'Class Management' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Allows selecting the academic year whose class list is to be shown. User: 2. Selects the academic year of interest. System: 3. Searches the archive for the classes and shows the class management screen. 4. Shows the list of classes of the selected academic year.
Postconditions: The system shows the list of classes of the selected academic year. The administrator interrupts the operations. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS14:
Name: InsertNewClass
Actors: Administrator
Description: Inserts a new class into the archive.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has already performed the use case 'ViewClassList' and the system is showing the list of classes of a particular academic year. The user clicks the 'New Class' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the form to fill in with: name, address (course of study), academic year. User: 2. Fills in the form. 3. Clicks the 'Save' button. System: 4. Checks the validity of the entered data and inserts the new class into the archive; if the entered data are not valid, activates the use case 'DataError'.
Postconditions: The user has inserted a class into the system. The data error is notified. The connection to the SMOS server is closed. The Administrator interrupts the operation.
SMOS15:
Name: ViewClassDetails
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows viewing the details of a class.
Preconditions: The user has already logged in. The user has already performed the use case 'ViewClassList' and the system is showing the list of classes of an academic year. The user clicks the 'show class details' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the screen with the details of a single class: name, address (course of study), school year.
Postconditions: The user sees the detailed information about a class. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS16:
Name: DeleteClass
Actors: Administrator
Description: Deletes a class from the archive.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewClassDetails'. The user sees the detailed information of a class. The user clicks the 'Delete' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Deletes the class from the archive. 2. Shows the updated list of classes.
Postconditions: The user has deleted a class. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS17:
Name: ViewAddressList
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows viewing the list of addresses (courses of study).
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system with the Administrator role. The user clicks the 'Address Management' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the list of addresses.
Postconditions: The system shows the list of the addresses present in the archive. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS18:
Name: InsertNewAddress
Actors: Administrator
Description: Inserts a new address (course of study) into the archive.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has already performed the use case 'ViewAddressList' and the system is showing the list of addresses. The user clicks the 'New Address' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the form to fill in with: address name. User: 2. Fills in the form. 3. Clicks the 'Save' button. System: 4. Checks the validity of the entered data and inserts a new address into the archive; if the entered data are not valid, activates the use case 'DataError'.
Postconditions: The user has inserted an address. The data error is notified. The connection to the SMOS server is closed. The Administrator interrupts the operation.
SMOS19:
Name: ViewAddressDetails
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows viewing the details of an address.
Preconditions: The user has already logged in. The user has already performed the use case 'ViewAddressList' and the system is showing the list of addresses. The user clicks the 'show address details' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the screen with the details of a single address; in particular: address name.
Postconditions: The user sees the detailed information about a single address. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS20:
Name: DeleteAddress
Actors: Administrator
Description: Deletes an address from the archive.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewAddressDetails'. The user sees the detailed information of an address. The user clicks the 'Delete' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Checks whether the address has associated classes; if so, shows the error message 'Cannot delete the address, delete the associated classes and try again', otherwise deletes the address. 2. Shows the updated list of addresses.
Postconditions: The user has deleted an address. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS21:
Name: AssignRemoveTeachings
Actors: Administrator
Description: Assigns or removes one or more teachings to or from an address (course of study).
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewAddressDetails'. The user sees the detailed information of an address. The user clicks the 'Address Teachings' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows a form from which teachings can be added to and/or removed from the address. User: 2. Selects the teachings to assign to or remove from the address. 3. Clicks the 'Send' button. System: 4. Associates or removes the selected teachings to or from the address. 5. Returns to the display of the address details.
Postconditions: The Administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed. The system has modified the teachings related to the address.
SMOS22:
Name: ViewTeachingList
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows viewing the list of teachings (subjects).
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system with the Administrator role. The user clicks the 'Teaching Management' button.
Event sequence: System: 1.-2. Searches the archive for the teachings, shows the teaching management screen and shows the list of teachings.
Postconditions: The system shows the list of the teachings present in the archive. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS23:
Name: InsertNewTeaching
Actors: Administrator
Description: Inserts a new teaching (subject) into the archive.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has already performed the use case 'ViewTeachingList' and the system is showing the list of teachings. The user clicks the 'New Teaching' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the form to fill in with: teaching name. User: 2. Fills in the form. 3. Clicks the 'Save' button. System: 4. Checks the validity of the entered data and inserts the new teaching into the archive; if the entered data are not valid, activates the use case 'DataError'.
Postconditions: The user has inserted a teaching. The error is notified. The connection to the SMOS server is closed. The Administrator interrupts the operation.
SMOS24:
Name: ViewTeachingDetails
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows viewing the details of a teaching.
Preconditions: The user has already logged in. The user has already performed the use case 'ViewTeachingList' and the system is showing the list of teachings. The user clicks the 'teaching details' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the screen with the details of a single teaching.
Postconditions: The user sees the detailed information of a single teaching. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS25:
Name: EditTeaching
Actors: Administrator
Description: Modifies the details of a teaching.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewTeachingDetails'. The user sees the detailed information of a teaching. The user modifies one of the items of information in the teaching details form.
Event sequence: User: 1. Clicks the 'Save' button. System: 2. Checks the validity of the entered data and modifies the teaching in the archive; if the entered data are not valid, activates the use case 'DataError'. 3. Shows the updated list of teachings.
Postconditions: The user has modified a teaching. The data error is notified. The connection to the SMOS server is closed. The Administrator interrupts the operation.
SMOS26:
Name: DeleteTeaching
Actors: Administrator
Description: Deletes a teaching from the archive.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewTeachingDetails'. The user sees the detailed information of a teaching. The user clicks the 'Delete' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Deletes the teaching from the archive. 2. Shows the updated list of teachings.
Postconditions: The user has deleted a teaching. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS27:
Name: ViewRegisterList
Actors: Administrator
Description: Shows the list of the (class) registers for an academic year.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. Clicks the 'Digital Register' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows a screen for selecting the academic year of interest. User: 2. Selects the school year. System: 3. Searches the archive for all the digital registers of that year and shows them associated with the class to which they belong.
Postconditions: The system is showing the list of registers for a particular academic year. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS28:
Name: ViewSingleRegisterDetails
Actors: Administrator
Description: Shows the details of one of the class registers.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user must have performed the use case 'ViewRegisterList'. Clicks the 'Details' button associated with one of the registers.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows on screen the information contained in the register organized by date. In particular it shows, for the current date, the list of pupils, specifying: absent/present, late arrivals, and a form from which justifications and disciplinary notes can be managed.
Postconditions: The system is showing the details of a class register. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS29:
Name: InsertAbsencesAdmin
Actors: Administrator
Description: Digitization of the register, data entry by the Administrator.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewSingleRegisterDetails'. Selects the date for which he or she wants to enter the information.
Event sequence: System: 1. Updates the displayed screen according to the date. User: 2. Fills in the form by entering absent/present students and clicks 'Save'. System: 3. Sends the data to the server. For every absence the server sends a notification e-mail to the pupil's parent. 4. Shows the updated register data.
Postconditions: The absence and lateness data have been entered into the system, and the system has sent the notifications to the parents. The system stays on the register screen. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS30:
Name: InsertLatenessAdmin
Actors: Administrator
Description: Digitization of the register, data entry by the Administrator.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewSingleRegisterDetails'. Selects the date for which he or she wants to enter the information.
Event sequence: System: 1. Updates the displayed screen according to the date. User: 2. Fills in the form by entering students who were late and clicks 'Save'. System: 3. Sends the data to the server. 4. Shows the updated register data.
Postconditions: The lateness data have been entered into the system, and the system has sent the notifications to the parents. The system stays on the register screen. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS31:
Name: EditAbsence
Actors: Administrator
Description: Modification of absences by the Administrator. The modification is to be understood as insertion/deletion of the absence.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewSingleRegisterDetails'. Selects the date for which he or she wants to modify an absence.
Event sequence: System: 1. Updates the screen according to the selected date. User: 2. Modifies the absence (inserts or deletes) and clicks 'Save'. System: 3. Sends the modified data to the server. The system sends a correction e-mail to the pupil's parent.
Postconditions: The system has modified the selected absence and has sent the parents a notification of the change. The system stays on the register screen. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS32:
Name: EditLateness
Actors: Administrator
Description: Modification of a lateness by the Administrator.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewSingleRegisterDetails'. Selects the date for which he or she wants to modify the lateness.
Event sequence: System: 1. Updates the screen according to the selected date. User: 2. Modifies the lateness and clicks 'Save'. System: 3. The system sends the modified data to the server.
Postconditions: The system has modified the lateness for the given date. The system stays on the register screen. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS33:
Name: DeleteLateness
Actors: Administrator
Description: Deletion of a lateness by the Administrator.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewSingleRegisterDetails'. Selects the date for which he or she wants to delete a lateness.
Event sequence: System: 1. Updates the screen according to the selected date. User: 2. Deletes the late entry of a student and clicks 'Save'. System: 3. Deletes the late entry from the archive.
Postconditions: The system has deleted the lateness. The system stays on the register screen. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS34:
Name: ViewJustificationList
Actors: Administrator
Description: Shows the list of justifications (of absences).
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewSingleRegisterDetails'. Clicks the 'Justifications' button related to a pupil.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows all the absences of the pupil recorded during the selected school year. Absences already justified are shown in green, those still to be justified in red.
Postconditions: The system is showing the list of justifications concerning the student. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS35:
Name: ViewNoteList
Actors: Administrator
Description: Shows the list of (disciplinary) notes concerning the student.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewSingleRegisterDetails'. Clicks the 'Notes' button associated with a student.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows all the notes of the pupil recorded during the school year.
Postconditions: The system is showing the list of notes referring to the student. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS36:
Name: InsertJustification
Actors: Administrator
Description: Insertion of a justification (of an absence).
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewSingleRegisterDetails'. The user has performed the use case 'ViewJustificationList'. The user clicks on one of the absences shown in red.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows a form in which to enter the fields of the justification (justification date). User: 2. Fills in the form. 3. Clicks 'Save'. System: 4. Saves the justification.
Postconditions: The justification data have been entered into the system. The system returns to the register screen. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS37:
Name: InsertNote
Actors: Administrator
Description: Insertion of disciplinary notes.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewSingleRegisterDetails'. The user has already performed the use case 'ViewNoteList'. The user clicks the 'New note' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows a form with the fields of the note (student, date, teacher, description). User: 2. Fills in the form. 3. Clicks 'Save'. System: 4. Saves the note and sends a notification by e-mail to the parent.
Postconditions: The note data have been entered into the system, and the system has sent the notification to the parents. The system returns to the register screen. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS38:
Name: ViewJustificationDetails
Actors: Administrator
Description: Shows the details of a justification.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewJustificationList'. Clicks on one of the absences shown in green.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows a form with the details of the justification and the possibility to modify or delete the justification.
Postconditions: The system is showing the details of a justification. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS39:
Name: ViewNoteDetails
Actors: Administrator
Description: Shows the details of a note.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewNoteList'. Clicks the 'details' button associated with one of the notes.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows a form with the details of the note: pupil, description, teacher, date.
Postconditions: The system is showing the details of a note. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS40:
Name: EditJustification
Actors: Administrator
Description: Modification of a justification.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewJustificationDetails' and the system is showing the details of a justification.
Event sequence: User: 1. Modifies one or more fields of the displayed form: justification date. 2. Clicks 'Save'. System: 3. Modifies the justification.
Postconditions: The justification has been modified. The system returns to the register screen. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS41:
Name: EditNote
Actors: Administrator
Description: Modification of a disciplinary note.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewNoteDetails'.
Event sequence: User: 1. The user modifies one or more fields of the displayed form: student, description, teacher, date. 2. The user clicks 'Save'. System: 3. The system saves the changes.
Postconditions: The note data have been modified. The system returns to the register screen. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS42:
Name: DeleteJustification
Actors: Administrator
Description: Deletes a justification.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewJustificationDetails' and the system is showing the details of a justification. Clicks 'Delete'.
Event sequence: System: 1. Deletes the justification.
Postconditions: The justification has been deleted from the system. The system returns to the register screen. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS43:
Name: DeleteNote
Actors: Administrator
Description: Deletion of disciplinary notes.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewNoteDetails' and the system is showing the details of a note. The user clicks the 'Delete' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. The system sends an erratum (correction) notification to the student's parents, then deletes the note data from the archive.
Postconditions: The note has been deleted, and the system has sent the notification to the parents. The system returns to the register screen. The administrator interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS44:
Name: PerformStudentMonitoring
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows querying the system about the number of absences and notes associated with the students.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as administrator. The user clicks the 'Student Monitoring' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Searches the archive for the students who, for the current school year, have a number of absences and notes above a predefined threshold. 2. Shows a screen presenting the data obtained.
Postconditions: The information about the pupils' absences and notes has been shown. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS45:
Name: ViewAReportCard
Actors: Administrator
Description: Viewing a report card.
Preconditions: The user has logged in to the system as Administrator. The user clicks the 'Online report cards' button.
Event sequence: User: 1. Selects the academic year. System: 2. Shows the list of the classes present in the system with a 'Report cards' button next to each class. User: 3. Chooses the class of the pupil whose report card he or she wants to view. System: 4. Shows the list of pupils of the class chosen by the user. User: 5. Selects the pupil and the term (quarter) whose report card is to be shown by clicking the relevant button. System: 6. Shows the report card of the chosen pupil for the selected term.
Postconditions: The system shows the report card of a student. The user interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS46:
Name: InsertReportCard
Actors: Administrator
Description: Insertion of a student's report card performed by the Administrator.
Preconditions: The user has logged in to the system as Administrator. The user clicks the 'Online report cards' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the list of the classes present in the system for the current academic year with a 'Report cards' button next to each class. User: 2. Chooses the class of the pupil whose report card is to be entered. System: 3. Shows the list of pupils of the class chosen by the user. User: 4. Selects the pupil for whom to insert the report card by clicking the relevant button. System: 5. Shows the form for inserting a report card. User: 6. Enters the grades of the report card, all or in part, and clicks the 'save' button. System: 7. Stores the entered grades in the archive and takes the user back to the page showing the students of the class.
Postconditions: The report card of a pupil has been added to the system. The user interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS47:
Name: EditAReportCard
Actors: Administrator
Description: Use case to modify the report card of a pupil.
Preconditions: The user has logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'ViewAReportCard'. The user clicks the edit button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the form with the fields that can be modified, including the grades of the different subjects. User: 2. Enters the new data and clicks the confirm button. System: 3. The system shows a confirmation message and shows the form with the list of pupils.
Postconditions: A report card of a pupil is modified. The user interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS48:
Name: DeleteAReportCard
Actors: Administrator
Description: The Administrator deletes a report card from the system.
Preconditions: The user has logged in to the system as Administrator. The user has performed the use case 'View a report card'. The user clicks the 'delete' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. The system shows a form to confirm the deletion. User: 2. The user accepts the deletion by pressing the confirm button. System: 3. Shows a message of successful deletion and shows the form with the list of classes.
Postconditions: A report card of a pupil is deleted. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS49:
Name: ViewEnrollmentRequests
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows the administrator to view the list of enrollment (registration) requests that have reached the system.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as administrator. The user clicks the 'View Enrollment Requests List' button on the home page.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the list of the enrollments still to be activated.
Postconditions: The user is viewing the list of requests for enrollment in the system made by students. The user interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS50:
Name: AcceptStudentEnrollment
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows the administrator to accept the enrollment of a student in the system.
Preconditions: The user has already performed the use case 'View Enrollment Requests'. The user clicks the 'Accept' button associated with an enrollment request.
Event sequence: System: 1. Activates the new user in the system. 2. Shows the list of the enrollments still to be activated.
Postconditions: The user has accepted a request for enrollment in the system. The user interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS51:
Name: RejectStudentEnrollment
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows the administrator to reject the enrollment of a student in the system.
Preconditions: The user has already performed the use case 'View Enrollment Requests'. The user clicks the 'Reject' button associated with an enrollment request.
Event sequence: System: 1. Deletes the enrollment request. 2. Shows the list of the enrollments still to be activated.
Postconditions: The user has rejected a request for enrollment in the system. The user interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS52:
Name: SearchEntity
Actors: Administrator
Description: Allows the administrator to search the system for all the entities characterized by the keywords entered.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as administrator. The user enters the text to search for and clicks the 'Search' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the list of entities related to the searched keywords; in particular, the following are shown in an active list: classes, teachings, addresses (courses of study), users found.
Postconditions: The user is viewing an active list of entities matching the entered keywords. The user interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS53:
Name: ViewClassList
Actors: ATA staff (school administrative, technical and auxiliary staff)
Description: Viewing of the classes.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as ATA staff.
Event sequence: System: 1. The system shows the user a screen with all the classes present in the database, with a button to access the register of each class.
Postconditions: The user is shown a list from which to choose the class.
SMOS54:
Name: InsertAbsences
Actors: ATA staff
Description: Digitization of the register, data collection by ATA staff class by class.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as ATA staff. The user has performed the use case ViewClassListATA. Selects a class for which to enter data into the system.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the user a screen with the pupils and radio buttons to select whether a pupil is absent or present. By default the pupil is present. User: 2. The user selects the absent students. 3. Clicks 'save'. System: 4. The system sends the data to the server. For every absence the server sends a notification e-mail to the pupil's parent.
Postconditions: The absence data have been entered into the system, and the system has sent the notifications to the parents. The initial screen is shown to the user again. The connection to the SMOS server is closed. The user interrupts the operation.
SMOS55:
Name: InsertLatenessATA
Actors: ATA staff
Description: Digitization of the register, data collection by ATA staff class by class.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as ATA staff. The user has performed the use case ViewClassListATA. Selects a class for which to enter data into the system.
Event sequence: System: 1. The system shows the user a screen with all the pupils present, with a 'late' checkbox beside each. If selected, select fields next to it are enabled to choose the time of the lateness. User: 2. The user selects the late arrivals. 3. The user clicks 'Confirm'. System: 4. The system sends the data to the server.
Postconditions: The lateness data have been entered into the system. The initial screen is shown to the user again. The connection to the SMOS server is closed. The user interrupts the operations.
SMOS56:
Name: ViewClassListTeacher
Actors: Teacher
Description: This use case allows a teacher to view the list of the classes in which he or she teaches.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as teacher. The user clicks the 'Digital Register' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the list of the academic years in which there is at least one class in which the teacher teaches. User: 2. Selects the academic year of interest. System: 3. Shows the classes associated with the selected school year.
Postconditions: The list of all the classes in which the teacher teaches has been shown. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS57:
Name: ViewRegister
Actors: Teacher
Description: Viewing of the class register.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as teacher. The user has performed the use case 'ViewClassList' and the system is showing the list of all the classes in which he or she teaches. The user clicks the 'Register' button associated with one of the classes.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the information relating to the class register, in particular: date, absences, disciplinary notes, lateness and justifications.
Postconditions: The information relating to the class register has been shown. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS58:
Name: ViewAReportCardTeacher
Actors: Teacher
Description: Viewing of a report card.
Preconditions: The user has logged in to the system as Teacher. The user clicks the 'Online report cards' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the list of the academic years in which there is at least one class in which the teacher teaches. User: 2. Selects the academic year of interest. System: 3. Shows the classes associated with the selected school year. User: 4. Selects one of the classes shown. System: 5. Shows the list of pupils of the class chosen by the user. User: 6. Selects the pupil whose report card is to be shown and the reference term by clicking the appropriate button. System: 7. Shows the report card of the chosen pupil for the specified term.
Postconditions: The system shows the report card of a student. The user interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS59:
Name: ViewAReportCardStudent
Actors: Student
Description: The report card of the pupil who requests it is shown.
Preconditions: The user has logged in to the system as Student. The user clicks 'online report card'.
Event sequence: System: 1. The system shows the report cards of the logged-in student present in the archive. User: 2. Selects the report card of interest. System: 3. Shows the details of the selected report card.
Postconditions: The system shows the report card of a pupil. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS60:
Name: ViewStudentSchoolData
Actors: Student
Description: Viewing of the school information concerning the user.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as student. The user clicks the 'Digital Register' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Searches the archive for the register data of the class to which the student belongs. 2. Shows the data relating to the student, in particular: date, absences, disciplinary notes, lateness and justifications.
Postconditions: The class register data relating to the student have been shown. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS61:
Name: ViewStudentsData
Actors: Parent
Description: This use case allows a parent to view the information relating to his or her own children.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as parent. The user clicks the 'Register' button associated with one of his or her children.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows a summary table with the information relating to the children, in particular: date, absences, disciplinary notes, lateness and justifications.
Postconditions: The information relating to one of the user's children has been shown. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS62:
Name: ViewAReportCard
Actors: Parent
Description: The report card of the requested pupil is shown.
Preconditions: The user has logged in to the system as Parent. The user clicks the report card button associated with one of his or her children.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the report cards of the selected student. User: 2. Selects the report card of interest. System: 3. Shows the details of the selected report card.
Postconditions: The system shows the report card of a student. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS63:
Name: PerformStudentMonitoring
Actors: Management (school headmaster's office)
Description: Allows viewing the students with a number of notes and absences above a threshold indicated by the user.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the system as management. The user clicks the 'Student Monitoring' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Searches for the students with a number of absences and notes above the established threshold. 2. Shows the retrieved information.
Postconditions: The information relating to the collected data has been shown. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS64:
Name: ViewRegisterList
Actors: Management
Description: Shows the list of the registers for an academic year.
Preconditions: The user must be logged in to the system as Management. The user clicks the 'Digital Register' button.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows a screen for selecting the academic year of interest. User: 2. Selects the academic year. System: 3. Searches the archive for all the digital registers of that year and shows them associated with the class to which they belong.
Postconditions: The system is showing the list of registers for a particular academic year. The management interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS65:
Name: ViewRegister
Actors: Management
Description: Details relating to the register of a class.
Preconditions: The user is logged in to the management system. The user has performed the use case 'ViewRegisterList' and the system is showing the list of all the registers of a particular academic year. The user clicks the 'Register' button associated with one of the classes.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows on screen the information contained in the register organized by date. In particular it shows, for the selected date, the list of pupils, specifying: absent/present, late arrivals, and a form from which justifications and disciplinary notes can be managed.
Postconditions: The information relating to the class register has been shown. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS66:
Name: ViewAReportCard
Actors: Management
Description: Viewing of a report card.
Preconditions: The user has logged in to the system as Management. The user clicks the 'Online report cards' button.
Event sequence: User: 1. Selects the academic year. System: 2. Shows the list of the classes present in the system with a 'Report cards' button next to each class. User: 3. Chooses the class of the pupil whose report card he or she wants to view. System: 4. Shows the list of pupils of the class chosen by the user. User: 5. Selects the pupil whose report card is to be shown and the term of interest by clicking the relevant button. System: 6. Shows the report card of the chosen pupil for the selected term.
Postconditions: The system shows the report card of a student. The user interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
SMOS67:
Name: RegistrationToTheSite
Actors: Visitor
Description: Allows a student to register in the system.
Preconditions: The user clicks the 'Register' button on the home page.
Event sequence: System: 1. Shows the registration form containing: first name, last name, mobile phone, e-mail, username, password, confirm password. User: 2. Fills in the form fields. 3. Submits the form. System: 4. Inserts the enrollment request into the system.
Postconditions: The user has made a request for enrollment in the system. The user interrupts the operation. The connection to the SMOS server is closed.
